articles.title: Ajit Doval, Russian first deputy PM review defence, energy ties
articles.summary: India's National Security Adviser Ajit Doval met Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov in Moscow. Their discussions focused on reviewing the strategic partnership between India and Russia, with a particular emphasis on strengthening defence cooperation. This high-level engagement underscores the ongoing importance of the bilateral relationship for both nations' security interests and strategic autonomy.

articles.title: Russian Drone Hits Apartment Building In NATO Member Country
articles.summary: A Russian drone reportedly crashed into an apartment building in Galati, Romania, near its Ukrainian border on Friday, injuring civilians. Romanian officials confirmed the incident, marking a direct impact on NATO territory amidst the ongoing conflict. This event raises significant concerns about spillover effects of the war, underscoring the critical importance of regional air defence and security.

articles.title: Ensure medical seat matrix & counselling stay undisturbed, House Panel tells govt
articles.summary: A parliamentary panel urged the government to ensure medical admissions' seat matrix and counselling schedules remain undisturbed. This directive, following briefings from top officials in New Delhi, emphasizes maintaining stability in the crucial process. The aim is to prevent disruptions for students pursuing medical education, ensuring a smooth and predictable admission timeline across the nation.

This military action unfolds amidst significant backlash faced by former President Trump regarding a proposed "disastrous peace deal plan." The strikes signal heightened tensions and a contentious foreign policy landscape, particularly concerning US engagement in the Middle East and the implications of the peace initiatives.

articles.title: Defence secy Rajesh Kumar Singh gets addl charge of DRDO chairman as Samir Kamat retires
articles.summary: Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh has been assigned the additional charge as Chairman of the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO). This significant appointment follows the retirement of the previous chairman, Samir Kamat. This move ensures continuity in leadership for India's crucial defence research and development initiatives, which is vital for national security and technological self-reliance.

articles.title: Photos: U.S. Women's Open features an upgrade in courses at Riviera
articles.summary: The U.S. Women's Open golf tournament has experienced a significant upgrade in its host courses over the last two decades. Traditionally held at regional country clubs, which, though solid, occasionally presented limitations, this shift indicates a strategic move towards more prominent or enhanced venues. This development aims to elevate the tournament's overall standing and participant experience.
